Que doit contenir le site internet d'un: What should a law firm website include?
Le site internet d'un avocat doit permet: A law firm website should let a client understand within seconds whether the firm handles their problem, what it might cost and how to book an appointment. It usually includes one page per practice area, a presentation of the lawyers and their background, a page dedicated to fees, practical information and a way to book an appointment, at the office or by video call. In France, lawyers have been allowed to advertise personally since 2014, provided they respect the core principles of the profession: dignity, fairness and confidentiality. Mandatory information, such as the bar the lawyer is registered with, must appear on the website.
